codeHint: Capital letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, for example FIN-OPS. The code cannot be changed later.
stepUpNote: You may be asked for a verification code from your authenticator app before this is applied.

problems.duplicateKey: A value you entered is already used by another record. See the highlighted field.

list.title: Users

list.caption: Users
list.search: Search by name, username or email

form.userTypeHint: The user type cannot be changed after the user is created.
form.externalEntityHint: The entity the person works for. It cannot be changed after the user is created.
form.mobileNumberHint: International format, for example +966501234567. The user confirms the number themselves with a code.
form.nationalIdHintNone: Optional. 10 digits: a National ID starts with 1, an Iqama number with 2. You may be asked for a verification code from your authenticator app.
form.nationalIdHintRecorded: Recorded: {current}. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new number. Remove it from the user's page.
form.directorySubjectIdHint: The identifier of the person's account in the AHDA directory. Sign-in uses it to recognize them.
form.directoryAttributesNote: The department, manager and job title of an internal user are read from the AHDA directory each time they sign in.
form.accountSourceHint: A directory account signs in with the AHDA directory. A local account signs in with a password kept on this platform. The type cannot be changed later.

detail.noAssignments: This user has no role assignments.

notice.endDateSet: The account end date was saved.

temporaryPassword.title: Temporary password for {name}
temporaryPassword.note: It is shown only this once and cannot be read back. Copy it now and give it to the person securely.
temporaryPassword.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the password and copy it yourself.

account.resetBody: The current password stops working, any lockout ends, and the person must set a new password at their next sign-in.
account.unlockBody: The person can try to sign in again straight away.
account.endsOnHint: Leave empty for no end date.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.body: Delete {name}? They can no longer sign in and leave every list. Their name stays on past records. This cannot be undone here.

bulk.disableBody: These users can no longer sign in until they are activated again; their data and history stay: {names}.
bulk.deleteBody: These users can no longer sign in and leave every list; their names stay on past records. This cannot be undone here: {names}.

permissions.title: Custom permissions
permissions.description: The user starts from their roles. Here you can grant or remove single permissions for this user only. A change applies at once and is recorded in the audit trail.
permissions.ownAccount: These are your own permissions, so you cannot adjust them here. Another administrator can adjust them from your user page.
permissions.none: No permission has been adjusted for this user.
permissions.caption: Permissions adjusted for {name}
permissions.choiceRole: Back to what the roles give

nationalId.title: National ID / Iqama
nationalId.hint: 10 digits: a National ID starts with 1, an Iqama number with 2. Nafath verification checks it.

userStatusDialog.disableBody: {name} will no longer be able to sign in. Their records, decisions and role assignments are kept unchanged and still show their name.
userStatusDialog.activateBody: {name} will be able to sign in again with the role assignments they held before.

assignRole.title: Assign role
assignRole.profileHint: A role's permissions come from its permission profile.
assignRole.externalProfileHint: Only roles that can be held by external users are listed.
assignRole.startsAtHint: Leave empty to start now. A start in the past is not accepted.
assignRole.endsAtHint: Leave empty for no end date.

assignScope.title: Assign department/entity
assignScope.internalNote: Optionally limit the assignment to a department, an external entity or a project.
assignScope.externalNote: An external user is assigned within their own entity, normally for one project, with a named AHDA sponsor.
assignScope.projectIdHint: The project's identifier, for example 3f2b8c1e-0000-4000-8000-000000000000. Required for a project manager from an external entity.
assignScope.sponsorHint: An active AHDA staff member who is accountable for this external user's access.
assignScope.anchorDepartmentOrProject: This role needs a department or a project.

assignments.title: Role assignments
assignments.description: Who holds which role, where, and for how long. An assignment is never edited; end it and assign again.
assignments.empty: No role assignments have been made yet.
assignments.emptyFiltered: No role assignments match these filters.
assignments.endBody: The user will lose the {role} role from their next action. The assignment stays on record as ended.

fields.name: Name

fields.showCreateInHeader: Show Create in the top bar

list.title: Roles
list.description: The platform's built-in roles and those created here. What each role may do is set by its permission profiles.

detail.profilesNote: Open a profile to see the permissions each of its versions grants.
detail.noProfiles: This role has no permission profiles.

edit.title: Edit role
edit.description: Change the role's names here. What it may do is set by its permission profiles.

create.title: New role
create.description: A new role starts with a draft permission profile. It grants nothing until that profile is validated and published.
create.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.
create.sourceHint: Copies the role's published profile, scopes, landing dashboard and external setting. You can change them below.

settings.title: Scopes and landing dashboard
settings.scopesHint: Limits what an assignment of this role may be anchored to.

actions.deactivateBody: The role is no longer offered for new assignments. Existing assignments continue until they are ended.
actions.reactivateBody: The role is offered for new assignments again.
actions.deleteBody: The role and its permission profiles are removed for good. A role someone has held cannot be deleted, only deactivated.

roles.showCreateHint: For roles that create items routinely. Whoever holds the permission can still create from the menu.

permissionMatrix.title: Permission matrix
permissionMatrix.description: Which permissions each permission profile grants, and at what scope. Open a version to see who drafted, validated and published it, or to change it.
permissionMatrix.caption: Permissions granted by each permission profile
permissionMatrix.empty: No permissions or profiles are available.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: AHDA's departments. A department linked to a directory reference is assigned to staff automatically at sign-in.
departments.name: Name
departments.directoryReferenceHint: The department's value in the AHDA directory, if staff should be placed in it automatically.
departments.empty: No departments have been created yet.
departments.activateBody: {name} will be available again for new assignments.
departments.deactivateBody: {name} will no longer be offered for new assignments. Existing records keep it.
departments.deleteBody: These departments leave every list and picker; records that name them keep the name. A department still in use is refused: {names}.

entities.title: External entities
entities.description: Organizations outside AHDA whose staff may be given access to specific projects.

entities.emptyFiltered: No external entities match these filters.

retire.title: Retire entity
retire.body: {name} will be retired permanently. Its users will not be able to sign in, and it cannot be activated again.

signInMethods.noMobileNumber: There is no mobile number on your profile. Ask your administrator to add it.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.instructions: This action needs a fresh verification code. Enter the code from your authenticator app.

create.title: New permission profile
create.description: A profile is what an assignment grants. Start from an existing version to copy its permissions, then adjust them before it is validated and published.

fields.sourceHint: The new profile's first draft holds the same permissions at the same scopes.
fields.baseRoleHint: The role the profile's holders act as. It also limits what the profile may grant.
fields.author: Prepared by

version.description: The permissions this version grants and the scope of each, beside the shipped default of its base role.
version.caption: Permissions granted by this version
version.differencesOnly: Show only the {count} permissions that differ from the shipped default

next.DRAFT: Draft: its author may change it. Then another administrator validates it.
next.VALIDATED: Validated: a third administrator, neither its author nor its reviewer, publishes it.
next.PUBLISHED: Published: it can be assigned and never changes. To change it, start a new version.
next.RETIRED: Retired: it can no longer be assigned.

masterData.title: Master data
masterData.description: The controlled lists forms offer: strategic portfolios and initiatives, sectors, regions and cities, priorities and the rest. A new value is a draft until it is validated and then published, by different people.
masterData.empty: This list has no value yet.
masterData.codeInvalid: Use capital letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
masterData.lifecycleNote: The value is saved as a draft. Someone else validates it, and a third person publishes it, before forms offer it.

requested.title: Requested values
requested.description: Values importers asked to add because their workbook names them and the platform’s lists do not. Add the value where it belongs, then mark the request added; the importer is notified.

passwordSelfService.changeDescription: After the change, sign in again with your new password. Every other session of your account ends too.
passwordSelfService.changeDescriptionDirectory: This changes your AHDA directory password, everywhere you use it. After the change, sign in again with your new password. Every other session of your account ends too.
passwordSelfService.managedBody: You sign in with your Microsoft account, so your password is changed at Microsoft and not on this platform.
passwordSelfService.managedContact: To change or reset it, contact the AHDA IT service desk.
passwordSelfService.directoryAccount: No message after a few minutes, or do you sign in with a Microsoft account?
passwordSelfService.forgotDescription: Enter your username. If a password can be reset for that account, a link to choose a new one goes to its e-mail address.
passwordSelfService.forgotSent: If a password can be reset for that account, a link is on its way to its e-mail address. It works once, for 30 minutes. At most one message is sent every 5 minutes, so check your junk folder before asking again.
passwordSelfService.linkInvalid: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
passwordSelfService.updatedBody: Sign in with your new password. Sessions started with the old one have ended.

passwordRules: At least 12 characters, mixing letters and digits, not the username, and none of your last 5 passwords.
temporaryPasswordRules: At least 12 characters, mixing letters and digits, and not the username.

projectStages.empty: No stages yet. Use Add stage to add the first one.
projectStages.title: Project stages
projectStages.description: The stages of a project and their weights. Saving makes a new version with its effective date, so earlier figures keep the weights they were calculated with. Removing a stage leaves it out of the next version; earlier versions keep it.
projectStages.total: Active stages total {total}%. They must total 100%.
projectStages.mustTotal: The active stages total {total}%. They must total 100%.
projectStages.namesRequired: Give every stage an Arabic and an English name.
projectStages.effectiveHint: Leave empty to take effect now. It cannot be in the past.
projectStages.needsAnother: Saved. This environment needs another administrator to validate or publish it.
projectStages.deleteVersionPublished: The version stops applying from now on and is removed from the list. Until you save a new version no stage setup applies — the version before it does not come back. Figures already calculated keep their weights.
projectStages.namesLanguage: Write each stage's Arabic name in Arabic and its English name in English.
